decision: Add egress_policy — a per-tenant declarative allowlist of which DataClass values MAY egress to which client-hosted LLM endpoint pattern — as one new tenant-isolated table in migration 038. Deny-by-default (no row = egress not permitted; no catch-all seeded), schema-dormant day-1 (no src/**/*.ts reads it; call-time enforcement is Stage-2/T-0045), and joined on the DataClass axis imported from src/core/data-classification.ts (T-0033, S-2; class is NOT redeclared, no egress column added to data_classification). Mirrors the data_classification (017) tenant-table contract: tenant_id-leading PK (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE (tenant_id, class, allowed_endpoint), class CHECK over the closed DataClass set, ENABLE+FORCE RLS, current_setting('choros.tenant_id', true)::uuid isolation policy, choros_app DML-only grant, listed in ci/checks/known_tenant_tables.txt. No new TS runtime module; the only TS artifact is a compile-time type-contract fixture pinning egress_policy.class to DataClass (AC-16).

rejected_alternatives.option: Add an egress column to data_classification
rejected_alternatives.why_not: T-0033 ADR §3.3 / seam S-1 explicitly excludes it. Egress is a separate axis (class×endpoint), not a property of a field's classification; conflating them couples two signed axes and breaks the frozen seam.

rejected_alternatives.option: Reference the LLM endpoint by a secret-handle FK
rejected_alternatives.why_not: BYO-LLM secret custody is T-0025 (out of scope). The endpoint is a policy-level text identifier, not a credential; an FK would create a phantom dependency and leak custody concerns into a policy table (FR-5).
The founder-signed axis is (class, endpoint). Field→class is already derivable via T-0033; per-field rows would duplicate the classification axis.

rejected_alternatives.option: Ship a runtime reader / enforcement now
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Enforcement at agent-call time is the Stage-2 cut (E5.10 / T-0045), parked by the founder. Day-1 is schema + policy expressibility only; a runtime reader would violate the dormancy invariant (AC-11 / NF-7).

Nothing reads the table day-1, so a module would be dead code. The only TS need — the class↔DataClass contract — is met by a compile-time test fixture under src/__tests__/, which keeps the table dormant.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.type: uuid NOT NULL — leading PK component; tenant scope

fields.name: id
fields.type: uuid NOT NULL — row identity; PK component

fields.name: class
fields.type: text NOT NULL — a DataClass value; CHECK (class IN ('public','internal','confidential','restricted'))

fields.name: allowed_endpoint
fields.type: text NOT NULL — client-hosted LLM endpoint pattern (base URL); NO FK, NOT a secret handle

fields.name: __rls__
fields.type: ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; POLICY egress_policy_tenant_isolation USING/WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('choros.tenant_id', true)::uuid)

fields.name: __grant__
fields.type: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON choros.egress_policy TO choros_app (DML only, no DDL)

contracts: DDL: migrations/038_egress_policy.sql is the single authoritative field/type contract (full DDL in ADR §2). 7 columns; PK (tenant_id, id); UNIQUE (tenant_id, class, allowed_endpoint); class CHECK over the closed DataClass set; ENABLE+FORCE RLS; tenant-isolation policy; choros_app DML grant.

Join axis (S-2): egress_policy.class === DataClass exported from src/core/data-classification.ts (T-0033). T-0041 imports DataClass; it does NOT redeclare it and adds NO egress column to data_classification. Pinned by the compile-time fixture src/__tests__/egress-policy.type-check.ts under tsc --noEmit.

Public TS surface: T-0041 adds NO new export. It CONSUMES the existing `DataClass` type only (test-only, compile-time edge). Downstream consumers (NOT in scope): T-0045 queries egress_policy(tenant_id, class, allowed_endpoint) at the Stage-2 agent-call egress boundary; agent_card.llm_endpoint (T-0020/T-0025) is the runtime source of the looked-up endpoint.

Deny-by-default (FR-4): the table is an allowlist; absence of a (class, allowed_endpoint) row = egress NOT permitted. No catch-all 'allow all' row is seeded for any tenant; the dev tenant starts empty.

File seam (rule 9): adds ONLY migrations/038_egress_policy.sql (039 reserve, unused). Additive non-frozen edits: ci/checks/known_tenant_tables.txt (+egress_policy), ci/checks/db/cross_tenant.test.ts (+seed fn + dispatcher case), package.json fitness script (+egress-policy-isolation.sh). Frozen byte-unchanged: data-classification.ts, grant-lattice.ts, grant-resolver.ts, object-handle.ts, all pre-existing migrations.

Runtime target: Postgres schema choros, single substrate; applied by migrations/run.mjs (choros_migrator), queried Stage-2 by choros_app (NOBYPASSRLS). Day-1 runtime read = NONE (dormant). No DB reachable in the design session, so live-DDL is a CI obligation (CI db job runs the migration; fitness:db + npm run fitness + tsc --noEmit prove the ACs).

fitness_functions.rule: migrations/038_egress_policy.sql exists and creates choros.egress_policy with PK (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE (tenant_id, class, allowed_endpoint), class CHECK over the closed DataClass set, ENABLE+FORCE RLS, and the choros_app DML grant (AC-1).
ci/checks/known_tenant_tables.txt lists egress_policy, so the cross-tenant CI suite iterates it with no test-source edit (AC-9).
Schema dormancy: grep -r 'egress_policy' src/ (excluding __tests__/ and comment lines) returns 0 runtime reads — no src/**/*.ts imports or queries the table day-1 (AC-11 / NF-7).
Migration seam: T-0041 adds only files numbered 038 (039 reserve); no migrations/03[2-7]_*.sql or 04*+ file exists (AC-12 / NF-5).
Deny-by-default: migration 038 seeds no catch-all 'allow all' row (no INSERT with wildcard class/endpoint); the dormant table starts empty (AC-14 / FR-4).

No parallel egress-policy store: no hardcoded egress allowlist token (egressPolicy / egress_allow / allowedEndpoints / EGRESS_ALLOWLIST) in src/ outside __tests__/ and comments; the DB table is the single source of truth (NF-2).
The class↔DataClass type contract fixture exists at src/__tests__/egress-policy.type-check.ts and imports DataClass from ../core/data-classification — the assertion tsc --noEmit enforces (AC-16).

egress_policy.class is exactly the closed DataClass set: 'top_secret' is NOT assignable to class (a @ts-expect-error directive), each of public/internal/confidential/restricted is, the round-trip class↔DataClass holds, and description is nullable. A drift between the CHECK vocabulary and DataClass turns a directive unused and fails the build (AC-16 / AC-15 / AC-6 type-level).

egress_policy has ENABLE + FORCE RLS and the tenant-isolation policy USING/WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('choros.tenant_id', true)::uuid); cross-tenant read/write from choros_app is denied; class CHECK rejects 'top_secret' and accepts the four valid classes; the UNIQUE (tenant_id, class, allowed_endpoint) rejects a duplicate; description NULL is accepted; choros_app has DML but no DDL (AC-2..AC-8, AC-15).
Migration 038 is idempotent: a second migration-runner pass is a no-op (schema_migrations version-skip; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + pg_policies guard as a second line) (AC-10).
